blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Department of Agriculture (DA) has once again declared Quezon province free of avian influenza, commonly known as bird flu. This situation comes following the implementation of disease control measures and subsequent negative test results. The provincial government’s Public Information Office (PIO) reported that Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel issued the declaration pursuant to Memorandum Circular No. 45 on Sept. 24. The circular officially recognizes Quezon as an avian influenza-free province. “The declaration is significant in ensuring the continued safe and orderly production and trade of poultry and poultry products in the province,” the PIO said in an […]...
